contran_945.message: Only straps, chains, blocking or mats secure the load.
The load is held by blocking or the body's walls, not by lashings.
Applies to split cargo on an open body.
Lashings are anchored to the truck's lashing points on the metal frame.
No room to travel along the truck, or diagonal devices hold the load.
Nothing above the headboard can slide forward over it.

securing.message: Only straps, chains, blocking or mats secure the load.
The load is held by blocking or the body's walls, not by lashings.
Applies to split cargo on an open body.
Lashings are anchored to the truck's lashing points on the metal frame.
No room to travel along the truck, or diagonal devices hold the load.
Nothing above the headboard can slide forward over it.
Every article's tiedowns add up to at least half its weight.
Every article has the tiedowns 393.110 asks for its length and weight.
No cargo is in contact with the front end structure.
Applies to cargo inside a van's walls.
No article on the deck is likely to roll.
A coil with its eye crosswise needs a cradle and tiedowns through the eye against forward and rearward motion.
No machinery of 10,000 lb or more.
Tiedowns are hooked to the truck's anchor points.
